mcqs.question: Which country topped the medal tally at the World Para Athletics Grand Prix 2026 held at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, New Delhi?
mcqs.explanation: India topped the medal tally at the World Para Athletics Grand Prix 2026 with 208 medals, including 75 gold, 69 silver and 64 bronze. Russia won 35 medals, while Bosnia & Herzegovina won 3; Haryana was the top-performing state at the 24th National Para Athletics Championships, not at the New Delhi Grand Prix.
